title: Operator least-privilege view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's privileges view: each repository's latest operator priv-profile as of as_of, as one row of declared-privilege posture (never finding counts), ranked by tier-2 surplus, then wildcard rules, then privileged workloads, then repository URL. Rows are Core's projection of the operator-priv-profile artifacts. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included; lists are never null. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

as_of.description: The filter's point in time; null reads the latest profiles.

rows.description: One row per repository in scope with a completed priv-profile.

row.description: One repository's latest priv-profile as the least-privilege rollup reads it.

privileged_workloads.description: Workloads asking for privileged mode or a host namespace, the headline; null when the profile does not say.

wildcard_rules.description: Rules with a wildcard; null when the profile does not say.

scc_requests.description: Security context constraints the operator requests, raw names as the profile lists them (a name may repeat).

no_scc_request_recorded.description: The profile's own flag: true when no SCC request was found, which is not the same as asking for none (an empty scc_requests list does not say which); null when the profile does not state it.

flags.description: High-privilege rule pattern (raw) to how many rules match it; a pattern is present only when it matched.

containers.description: Containers across the listed workloads; null when the profile lists no workloads.

privileged_containers.description: Of those, the privileged ones; null with containers.

run_as_non_root_containers.description: Of those, the ones running as non-root (a container unset inherits its pod's); null with containers.

install_modes.description: The names of the OperatorGroup install modes the profile marks supported (the artifact's install_modes object, its true entries), names raw.

kubebuilder_markers.description: Kubebuilder RBAC markers in source, raw from the profile's tier-2 comparison; null when not derivable.

surplus.description: Privilege shipped with no marker asking for it (tier-2), raw from the profile; null when not derivable.

distinct_rule_triples.description: Distinct (API group, resource, verb) grants the RBAC rules expand to.

allOf.$comment: Container posture is listed with the workloads, or not at all.
